blocks.text: Automation SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) is a type of software used to acquire data from remote locations and monitor and control industrial systems and processes. It is typically used in industrial settings, such as manufacturing plants and power grids, to monitor and control equipment, detect faults, and manage operations.

SCADA systems also have the ability to collect and analyse data from multiple sources, such as sensors, and can be used to generate reports, control alarms, and provide real-time analysis. SCADA systems are often integrated with other control systems, such as Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and Distributed Control Systems (DCS). This allows for the automation of complex processes and the integration of different systems for better process control and management. SCADA systems are also used in many other industries, such as water, wastewater, and oil and gas. They can be used to monitor and control a variety of processes, from transportation to distribution and from production to energy management.

items.text: BMS- Integration of extensive devices to the system Is to use an IoT platform. An IoT platform can provide a unified platform for all connected devices, allowing for secure, reliable data exchange and communication. The IoT platform should support a wide range of devices, protocols, and applications, enabling developers to easily integrate and manage their connected devices. Additionally, the platform should offer a range of data analytics and visualization tools to help users gain insights from their data. By using an IoT platform, businesses can ensure that connected devices are integrated and managed in a secure, reliable, and cost-effective way.

Sub Metering and VFD’s Is to install an Automated Meter Reading (AMR) system. An AMR system combines the latest in metering technology with a user-friendly software platform to provide real-time data and analytics on energy consumption, allowing for smarter energy management decisions. Additionally, an AMR system can be used to control Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and other motor-driven equipment, helping to reduce energy costs and improve efficiency.
